title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of CAV Platoon Joining Maneuvers in Mixed Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2608.26860v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning offers a promising approach to improving road safety and traffic capacity. However, platoon control in real-world traffic is challenging due to uncertainty and heterogeneous driving behaviors. Reinforcement learning (RL) has strong potential for addressing such control problems, but its practical deployment raises challenges related to safety and learning efficiency. This paper proposes a generic modeling and simulation framework for investigating CAV platoon joining maneuvers and comparing deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based control algorithms. The problem is particularly challenging in mixed-traffic environments, where CAVs coexist with human-driven vehicles exhibiting heterogeneous longitudinal and lateral behaviors. translated_title: 混合交通中基于强化学习的CAV车队加入机动控制
translated_abstract: 连接和自动化车辆（CAV）车队技术为提高道路安全和交通容量提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，在真实交通中，由于不确定性和异质驾驶行为，车队控制面临挑战。强化学习（RL）在解决此类控制问题方面具有强大潜力，但其实际部署涉及安全性和学习效率方面的挑战。本文提出了一个通用建模和仿真框架，用于研究CAV车队加入机动并比较基于深度强化学习（DRL）的控制算法。在混合交通环境中，CAV与表现出异质纵向和横向行为的人类驾驶车辆共存，这一问题尤为棘手。目标是通过将风险行为的惩罚纳入学习过程或使用外部机制，实现安全高效的加入机动。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通用框架，用于在混合交通中通过强化学习实现CAV车队安全高效的加入机动，通过惩罚风险行为或外部机制提升控制性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generic framework for safe and efficient CAV platoon joining maneuvers in mixed traffic using reinforcement learning, enhancing control via risk penalty or external mechanisms.
